```{r overview-prep}
# Clinical overview: OVERVIEW is built in the setup chunk by build_overview()
# (R/key_findings.R): list(findings, biomarkers, per_panel_n, tumour_only, n_nonpanel).
# The heading is "## Overview" in _header.qmd and the gene-list chips (_gene_filter.qmd) sit
# between it and this file. Which rows show is decided client-side by
# assets/js/key_findings.js from the chips; R emits every row with data-gene / data-panels /
# data-tier.
ov = OVERVIEW
kf = if (!is.null(ov$findings)) ov$findings else empty_findings()
ov_panels = if (length(all_panels) > 0) names(all_panels) else character(0)
ov_label = function(p) ifelse(nzchar(p), paste0(toupper(substr(p, 1, 1)), substr(p, 2, nchar(p))), p)
ov_role = c(oncogene = "oncogene", tsg = "TSG", both = "oncogene/TSG")
ov_type = c(`small variant` = "Small variant", SV = "SV", CNA = "Copy number")
ov_num = function(x, digits = 2) ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = digits))
```

### Key findings {#key-findings}

```{r key-findings}
# One <tbody class="kf-group"> per gene (or per rearrangement joining two listed genes), one
# <tr> per alteration. Tier, gene and list cells are emitted on every line; key_findings.js
# marks the first shown line of a group as its head and hides them on the others.
if (!"genes" %in% names(kf)) kf[, genes := gene]
kf_groups = unique(kf$gene)
kf_row = function(i, group_loh) {
  r = kf[i]
  role = if (!is.na(r$role) && nzchar(r$role)) ov_role[[r$role]] else NULL
  lists = strsplit(r$panels, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lists = lists[nzchar(lists)]
  vaf = ov_num(r$vaf)
  dp = if ("dp" %in% names(r) && !is.na(r$dp)) paste0("DP ", formatC(r$dp, format = "d", big.mark = ",")) else ""
  tags$tr(
    class = paste0("kf-row kf-tier-", r$tier),
    `data-gene` = toupper(r$gene), `data-panels` = r$panels,
    `data-tier` = r$tier, `data-type` = r$type,
    tags$td(class = "kf-tier", tags$span(class = "kf-tier__label", paste("Tier", r$tier))),
    tags$td(class = "kf-gene",
            tags$span(class = "kf-gene__symbol", r$gene),
            if (!is.null(role)) tags$span(class = "kf-gene__role", role),
            if (group_loh) tags$span(class = "kf-gene__flag", "LOH in gene")),
    tags$td(class = "kf-alt",
            tags$span(class = "kf-alt__type", ov_type[[r$type]]),
            tags$span(class = "kf-alt__text", r$alteration),
            if (!is.na(r$locus) && nzchar(r$locus) && r$type == "small variant")
              tags$span(class = "kf-alt__locus", r$locus)),
    tags$td(class = "kf-evidence", r$evidence),
    tags$td(class = "kf-vaf", vaf, if (nzchar(dp)) tags$span(class = "kf-vaf__dp", dp)),
    tags$td(class = "kf-lists", if (length(lists)) paste(ov_label(lists), collapse = ", ") else "—")
  )
}
kf_group = function(g) {
  idx = which(kf$gene == g)
  # LOH is a property of the gene: flagged once, unless a line's evidence already says it
  loh = any(kf$loh[idx] %in% TRUE) && !any(grepl("LOH", kf$evidence[idx], fixed = TRUE))
  tags$tbody(class = "kf-group", `data-gene` = toupper(g),
             `data-genes` = toupper(kf$genes[idx[1]]),
             lapply(idx, kf_row, group_loh = loh))
}

per_n = ov$per_panel_n
hint_buttons = lapply(ov_panels, function(p) {
  n = if (!is.null(per_n) && p %in% names(per_n)) per_n[[p]] else 0L
  tags$button(type = "button", class = "kf-hint", `data-panel` = p,
              paste0(ov_label(p), " · ", n, " gene", if (n == 1) "" else "s",
                     " with tier 1–2 findings"))
})

np = ov$n_nonpanel
n_np = if (!is.null(np$kept)) np$kept else 0L

tags$div(
  id = "kf-root",   # not "key-findings": Quarto gives that id to the heading's section
  class = "kf",
  tags$p(class = "kf-intro",
    "Alterations in the genes of the ticked gene list(s) that carry evidence of being drivers. ",
    "A gene is only considered when it is on a list: there is no built-in cancer-gene catalogue."),
  if (isTRUE(ov$tumour_only))
    tags$p(class = "kf-caveat",
      tags$strong("Tumour-only sample: "),
      "without a matched normal, these calls can include germline variants. VAF is shown for judgement ",
      "(a germline heterozygous variant sits near 0.5, or near 1 under LOH)."),
  if (isTRUE(ov$tumour_only) && !is.null(verdict_note(ov$verdict)))
    tags$p(class = paste("kf-caveat", if (identical(ov$verdict$status, "skipped")) "kf-caveat--strong"),
           verdict_note(ov$verdict)),
  tags$ul(class = "kf-legend", `aria-label` = "Tier legend",
    tags$li(class = "kf-legend__item kf-tier-1", tags$strong("Tier 1"),
            " strong evidence: ClinVar (likely) pathogenic or truncating variant, breakpoint in the gene, amplification or homozygous / deep deletion"),
    tags$li(class = "kf-legend__item kf-tier-2", tags$strong("Tier 2"),
            " weaker: predicted-damaging missense, loss of function in an oncogene, SV with no exon annotated"),
    tags$li(class = "kf-legend__item kf-tier-3", tags$strong("Tier 3"),
            " low confidence: SV near (not in) the gene, intronic SV, copy number in a pseudoautosomal or IG/TR locus")),
  if (length(ov_panels) == 0)
    section_notice("No gene list is embedded in this report, so no key findings can be listed.")
  else tags$div(class = "kf-need-list",
    tags$p(class = "kf-need-list__text", "Key findings need a gene list — tick one above."),
    tags$div(class = "kf-hints", hint_buttons)),
  tags$p(class = "kf-print-panels", "Gene list(s): none"),
  tags$div(class = "kf-empty section-notice", hidden = NA,
           "No findings in the selected gene list(s): no listed gene carries a qualifying small variant, rearrangement or copy-number change."),
  tags$div(class = "kf-table-wrap", hidden = NA,
    tags$table(class = "kf-table", `data-quarto-disable-processing` = "true",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(
        tags$th(scope = "col", "Tier"), tags$th(scope = "col", "Gene"),
        tags$th(scope = "col", "Alteration"), tags$th(scope = "col", "Evidence"),
        tags$th(scope = "col", class = "kf-vaf", "VAF"),
        tags$th(scope = "col", "Gene list"))),
      lapply(kf_groups, kf_group))),
  tags$div(class = "kf-actions",
    tags$button(type = "button", class = "kf-toggle-low", hidden = NA, `aria-expanded` = "false",
                "Show lower-confidence findings"),
    tags$span(class = "kf-count")),
  tags$p(class = "kf-custom-note table-footnote", hidden = NA,
    "A Custom… list matches by gene symbol among the findings of the embedded gene lists and ",
    formatC(n_np, format = "d", big.mark = ","), " small variant", if (n_np == 1) "" else "s",
    " outside them (ClinVar pathogenic / likely pathogenic or HIGH impact",
    if (!is.null(np$total) && np$total > n_np)
      paste0("; the strongest ", formatC(n_np, format = "d", big.mark = ","), " of ",
             formatC(np$total, format = "d", big.mark = ",")) else "",
    "). Structural and copy-number changes are only listed for genes on a gene list.")
)
```

```{r key-findings-details}
table_details(
  summary = "How key findings are chosen",
  "One row per gene, listing each of its alterations; the tier shown is the gene's strongest. ",
  tags$br(),
  tags$strong("Small variants"), " (per variant and gene; the gene must be in the list's small-variant scope): ",
  "ClinVar pathogenic / likely pathogenic (“Conflicting classifications” never counts), or VEP impact HIGH, ",
  "or impact MODERATE with AlphaMissense likely pathogenic — where AlphaMissense gives no call, EVE pathogenic, ",
  "or SIFT deleterious together with PolyPhen probably damaging. The predicted-missense route is tier 2.",
  tags$br(),
  tags$strong("Structural variants"), " (both callers; calls of the two callers whose breakpoints agree within ",
  fmt_bp(KF_SV_SAME_EVENT_BP), " are one event, typed by whichever caller typed it, and both callers are named. ",
  "A rearrangement with breakpoints in two listed genes is one row for both): ",
  "tier 1 when a breakpoint lies in the gene, a deletion/duplication of at most ", fmt_bp(KF_FOCAL_SV_MAX),
  " covers it, or Padfoot rates the event HIGH for that gene. A gene merely inside a larger event is left to copy number. ",
  "A deletion/duplication/insertion that VEP annotated without an exon effect is tier 3, one with no annotation at all, ",
  "or that Padfoot rated below HIGH, tier 2. Within ", fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND), " of a breakend (",
  fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER), " of other events) the gene is listed as “near” at tier 3, at most ",
  KF_MAX_PROXIMITY_PER_GENE, " rows per gene. Events of locus size inside IG/TR loci are V(D)J recombination: tier 3.",
  tags$br(),
  tags$strong("Copy number"), " (gene-level calls of the Copy number section): amplification or homozygous deletion (deep deletion: below the high-ploidy threshold but not CN 0). ",
  "Calls in a pseudoautosomal region (", if (!is.null(params$reference)) params$reference else "", ") and in IG/TR loci are tier 3. ",
  "Loss of heterozygosity is not a finding on its own; it is noted on the gene's other rows, and with a listed small variant ",
  "reads “possible biallelic (LOH)”.",
  tags$br(),
  tags$strong("Gene roles"), " (the list's ", tags$code("role"), " column): a truncating variant or homozygous deletion of an ",
  "oncogene drops to tier 2, amplification of a tumour suppressor is not listed, a biallelic hit in a tumour suppressor is tier 1."
)
```

### Genome-wide biomarkers {#biomarkers}

```{r biomarkers}
bm = ov$biomarkers
bm_row = function(b, tier = NULL) {
  tags$div(class = paste0("bm-row bm-", b$status, " bm-id-", b$id),
    `data-ss-min` = tier,
    hidden = if (!is.null(tier) && tier != SHATTERSEEK_MIN_TIER_DEFAULT) NA,
    tags$div(class = "bm-label", b$label,
             if (!is.null(tier)) shatterseek_tier_select(class = "bm-tier-select")),
    tags$div(class = "bm-value",
             b$value,
             if (identical(b$status, "warn")) tags$span(class = "bm-flag", "check")),
    if (!is.null(b$items) && length(b$items) > 0)
      tags$ul(class = "bm-items", lapply(b$items, tags$li))
    else if (nzchar(b$detail)) tags$div(class = "bm-detail", b$detail))
}
# The chromothripsis card has one row per ShatterSeek minimum-tier setting; the selector
# (shared with the Chromothripsis section, script in _instability.qmd) shows one
tags$div(class = "bm-list",
  lapply(bm, function(b) {
    if (is.null(b$views)) bm_row(b)
    else tagList(lapply(names(b$views), function(t) bm_row(b$views[[t]], as.integer(t))))
  }))
```

```{r sequencing-cards}
# The old header's "Sequencing" group, kept as a compact secondary row under the overview
fmt_val = function(x, digits = 2) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("N/A")
  if (is.numeric(x) && !is.integer(x)) return(round(x, digits))
  as.character(x)
}
card = function(label, value, css_class = "", subtitle = NULL) {
  div(class = paste("metric-card", css_class),
      div(class = "metric-card__label", label),
      div(class = "metric-card__value", value),
      if (!is.null(subtitle)) div(class = "metric-card__subtitle", subtitle))
}
phasing = whatshap_totals(SECTION_DATA$whatshap)
n50_full = !is.null(qc_cramino) && !is.null(qc_cramino$n50_aligned) && !is.na(qc_cramino$n50_aligned)

div(class = "metric-group overview-sequencing",
  div(class = "metric-group__title", "Sequencing"),
  div(class = "metric-grid",
    card("Mean coverage",
         if (!is.null(qc_mosdepth) && !is.na(qc_mosdepth$mean_depth)) paste0(fmt_val(qc_mosdepth$mean_depth), "×") else "N/A",
         "metric-coverage"),
    card("Read N50",
         if (!is.null(qc_cramino) && !is.na(qc_cramino$n50)) fmt_bp(qc_cramino$n50) else "N/A", "metric-n50",
         # cramino 2.0 also reports an aligned-length N50; the card shows the full read length one
         subtitle = if (n50_full) "full read length" else NULL),
    card("Error rate",
         if (!is.null(samtools_stats) && !is.na(samtools_stats$error_rate))
           paste0(formatC(samtools_stats$error_rate * 100, format = "f", digits = 3), "%") else "N/A",
         "metric-error"),
    # Omitted, not "N/A", when there is no phasing (QC > Phasing carries the notice)
    if (!is.null(phasing))
      card("Phased variants",
           if (!is.na(phasing$phased)) formatC(phasing$phased, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
           else sprintf("%.1f%%", phasing$fraction * 100),
           "metric-phased",
           subtitle = paste(c(
             if (is.na(phasing$phased) || is.na(phasing$fraction)) NULL
             else if (!is.na(phasing$heterozygous))
               sprintf("%.1f%% of %s heterozygous", phasing$fraction * 100,
                       formatC(phasing$heterozygous, format = "d", big.mark = ","))
             else if (identical(phasing$denominator, "variants") && !is.na(phasing$variants))
               sprintf("%.1f%% of %s variants", phasing$fraction * 100,
                       formatC(phasing$variants, format = "d", big.mark = ","))
             else sprintf("%.1f%% phased", phasing$fraction * 100),
             "germline, WhatsHap"), collapse = " · "))
  )
)
```
